messages:
elaine: Heads-up — AcmeCorp's new CLI v2 is dropping support for legacy auth headers next week. They pinged partnerships asking for compatibility plan. https://acme.example/cli-changelog :eyes:
acme-pm: Hey team, yep we rolled out the change in staging. We can toggle a flag for partners but need a Redwood-side shim or clear deprecation comms by EOD Thu.
matt: @elaine can you paste the exact header payload? I want to check SDK parsing.
elaine: snippet: 
```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Acme-Auth: v2;sig=...
```
They are removing X-Acme-Auth and expecting JWT in Authorization only.
sophie: Quick thought — we can add a compatibility layer in the SDK that reads X-Acme-Auth and rewrites into Authorization. Low risk shim, can ship in patch release.
vincent: Agree. Need to ensure telemetry flags to track how many partners still send X-Acme-Auth. Also coordinate marketplace listing update and partner comms.
matt: Tech impl: add header fallback in request middleware, sample:
```
if (!req.headers['authorization'] && req.headers['x-acme-auth']) {
  req.headers['authorization'] = convertXAcme(req.headers['x-acme-auth'])
}
```
We should gate behind feature flag for dedicated/private customers first.
acme-pm: Flag sounds good. We'll hold aggressive cutover until Redwood confirms rollout plan. ETA for flag TTL = 30 days?
sophie: I'll draft the partner-facing note with timeline + SDK patch notes. Can we aim to ship SDK 3.2.1 as patch today and console toggle tomorrow?
elaine: @matt @sophie can you confirm estimated PR + QA time? I told Acme we'd share a comm plan by EOD.
matt: PR by 2pm PST, QA by 6pm. I'll create canary release for CI integrations.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: sdk/3.2.1-canary -> staging at 2025-11-05T18:10:00Z :rocket:
vincent: Great. @acme-pm we'll follow up with a partner runbook: fallback shim, deprecation date (30 days from toggle), and rollback steps.
acme-pm: Thanks — we'll hold prod cut for 30 days after toggle. Appreciate the fast turnaround :pray:
sophie: I'll post the draft note in partnerships/docs and ping legal for wording.
elaine: Thanks all — I'll close the loop with Acme in the afternoon. :thumbsup:
